question: As per the 2011 census, what is the density of population in Arunachal Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**17 persons/km²**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The population density of Arunachal Pradesh as per the 2011 census is **17 persons per square kilometer**.
 
• Arunachal Pradesh is one of the states in India with the lowest population density.
 
• This low density is attributed to its vast geographical area and relatively small population.
 
• Arunachal Pradesh is located in the northeastern part of India and shares international borders with Bhutan, China, and Myanmar.
 
• The state is known for its diverse ethnic groups and rich cultural heritage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The state has a total area of 83,743 square kilometers.
 
• Arunachal Pradesh was granted statehood on **20th February 1987**.
 
• The capital of Arunachal Pradesh is **Itanagar**.
 
• The state is known for its scenic beauty, including the Himalayas, rivers, and forests.
 
• Arunachal Pradesh has several tribes, each with its own unique culture and traditions.
 
• The state is also home to a variety of flora and fauna, making it a biodiversity hotspot.
